_doc: D021b dependency metadata. Describes modules that lazysite's shipped code uses. Does NOT declare which modules exist - make-release.sh's strict-grep check greps the code and demands that every module it finds is listed here. To add a new dependency: add its entry, not just a use statement. Core-Perl modules are listed for completeness (Debian ships them in perl-modules-*; other distros include them with the perl package).

Cwd.used_by: path validation (realpath) across processor and manager-api

DB_File.used_by: rate limits: login, form submission, manager upload
DB_File._note: Bundled with perl core; links against libdb.

DBD::SQLite.used_by: data plugin: the SQLite storage engine (tier zero, one file at lazysite/db/data.sqlite)
DBD::SQLite._note: Bundles SQLite itself; no server to provision, which is why it is the default engine.

DBI.used_by: data plugin: the database interface every adapter is written against

Digest::SHA.used_by: HMAC-SHA256 for auth cookies, CSRF tokens, form tokens; salted iterated SHA-256 password hashing

Encode.used_by: UTF-8 decoding of query-string values in processor

Errno.used_by: EACCES/EPERM detection for the actionable permission hint on manager write failures (Lazysite::Manager::Common)

Exporter.used_by: import() for the shared Lazysite::* modules (SM079)

FCGI.used_by: FastCGI accept loop (SM142, optional; lazy-required - plain CGI needs nothing)

FCGI::ProcManager.used_by: FastCGI prefork pool (SM142, optional; lazy-required when LAZYSITE_FCGI_WORKERS>0)

Fcntl.used_by: file locking (flock), O_RDWR/O_CREAT constants for DB_File ties

File::Find.used_by: cache walks, directory enumeration for audit and manager API

File::Temp.used_by: zip download tempfile, theme upload staging

FindBin.used_by: locating the module tree relative to a tool (lazysite-acl.pl, lazysite-apache-vhost.pl) so it runs in place, from a tarball, or from a package install

HTTP::Tiny.used_by: domain-check marker fetch over HTTPS (SM156; lazy-required)

IO::Select.used_by: SM294 front-door relay - pumps a forked surface's stdin/stdout both directions so a large request body cannot deadlock against a large response; lazy-required, only on the relayed path

IO::Socket::SSL.used_by: SMTP form delivery over STARTTLS; domain-check TLS/cert probe (SM156, lazy-required)

IPC::Open2.used_by: users-admin child process, form webhook delivery with captured output

JSON::PP.used_by: manager API responses, form payloads, plugin --describe, SBOM/manifest output

LWP::UserAgent.used_by: remote content fetch for :::include and url: variables, form webhook delivery

MIME::Base64.used_by: HTTP Basic auth decoding in lazysite-dav.pl (WebDAV endpoint)

Net::SSLeay.used_by: domain-check certificate expiry read (SM156; also IO::Socket::SSL's own backend)

Net::XMPP.used_by: XMPP notification delivery (notify-xmpp plugin, optional; lazy-required only when enabled)

POSIX.used_by: strftime for timestamps in logs, manifest, SBOM, zip filenames

Socket.used_by: SSRF guard: inet_aton / inet_ntoa for remote-fetch IP address checks

Sys::Syslog.used_by: optional syslog forwarding of audit trail + diagnostics (Lazysite::Util::forward_line, the Logging & forwarding plugin)

Template::Parser.used_by: SM071 layout.tt compile validation in the control API (ships with Template)

Time::HiRes.used_by: dev server request timing (optional; falls back when unavailable)

Time::Local.used_by: timelocal in lazysite-users.pl parse_when (account expiry dates)

URI.used_by: URL parsing in SSRF guard and remote-fetch path resolution

YAML::PP.used_by: data plugin: reading table field descriptors
YAML::PP._note: A pure-Perl YAML parser chosen over YAML::XS deliberately - the descriptors are small, and a pure-Perl parser is one fewer compiled dependency on the rare architectures v1 still supports.

web_assets.name: qrcode-generator
web_assets.used_by: manager 2FA enrolment QR (rendered client-side from the otpauth URI)

web_assets.name: barlow
web_assets.used_by: manager UI typography (Barlow, Barlow Condensed) - bundled rather than fetched from a CDN so the manager makes no external request

environment.name: perl
environment.description: Perl runtime. Required version 5.10+. On Debian: 'perl'. On Alpine: 'perl'. On RHEL: 'perl'. Includes core modules listed above.

environment.name: git
environment.description: Host binary for the SM085 content history (conf key 'git_history: enabled'). Optional - only needed when the feature is enabled; invoked list-form (never through a shell), never a Perl module. Saves keep working without it (lazysite-check WARNs). Debian: 'git'.

environment.name: Apache HTTP Server
environment.description: CGI host. Operator-provided. Any CGI/1.1-capable server works; Apache is the reference platform. The dev server (tools/lazysite-server.pl) is evaluation-only.
